label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 136 ]

blocks.text: Poetry moves us to sympathize with the emotions of the poet himself or with those of the persons whom his imagination has created. We witness their struggles, triumphs and failures. We feel their loves and losses, joys and sorrows, hopes and fears, somewhat as if they were our own. Though we sometimes suffer along with their anxieties and sorrows, we receive a pleasure from the experience. Poetry provides us with what is missing in our own lives—the experience of imaginative pleasure. That is why we appreciate poetry in everyday life.
